findings.evidence: `BasicCycles.lean:80` provides `fullyBlockedBoundaries_le_cycles` only conditional on square-zero, while `Homology/Basic.lean:80-81` defines `fullyBlockedBoundariesInCycles` using `submoduleOf` (the intersection with cycles). Repository grep finds no unconditional global square-zero theorem, only `fullyBlockedDifferential_comp_self_eq_zero_iff` at `Differential/Square/Coefficient.lean:93`.
findings.fix: First prove the global theorem `fullyBlockedDifferential.comp fullyBlockedDifferential = 0` and use it to construct the genuine quotient ker ∂/im ∂, then induce these three equivalences; otherwise rename them explicitly as subquotient equivalences and do not claim Lane G homology symmetry.
findings.issue: `fullyBlockedHomologyTransposeEquiv`, `fullyBlockedHomologyRotateEquiv` (line 133), and `fullyBlockedHomologySwapMarkingsEquiv` (line 171) are called homology equivalences without proving im ∂ ≤ ker ∂; their source and target are only ker ∂/(im ∂ ∩ ker ∂), which need not be homology.

summary: The three equivalences are presented as homology symmetries before the required global square-zero theorem exists, so they only act on the surrogate quotient ker ∂/(im ∂ ∩ ker ∂).
